verdicts.reason: A breaks the reading order and hierarchy: the 'Longest Day Sale' banner has dropped below the body copy, and the legal line is set nearly as large as the subhead, packed tight under it. The headline wraps with an orphaned 'last', the bottle floats alone on the left above a big empty area, and the logo is shoved into the bottom-left corner. B keeps the original's top-to-bottom order (brand/banner, bottle, headline, offer, CTA) with a clear focal headline and CTA. Its flaws: the full-width headline runs close to the side edges, the fine print is too prominent and sits between the offer and the CTA, and the tilted banner (top-left) and logo (top-right) don't line up with each other or with the centred column.
